events.what_it_is: Three-day SACHEU beauty pop-up with immersive activations, games, prizes, product consultations and a chance to meet founder Sarah Cheung.
events.what_is_free: A full-size product for attendees while supplies last; games and prizes are also advertised.
events.caveats: RSVP does not guarantee entry, attendance, or a reserved place in line. Entry is first come, first served and subject to venue capacity. Promotional items are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: September 18–20, 11 AM–5 PM daily at 541 W 25th St.

events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary x SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: Three-day Japanese-wellness-themed Apothékary takeover of SUKOSHI with tongue readings, tincture sampling, ingredient education and kakigori.
events.what_is_free: First 50 guests in line each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture; tincture samples and kakigori are advertised while supplies last.
events.caveats: Free items and kakigori are while supplies last. A separate gift with purchase requires a purchase; do not describe that gift as an unconditional freebie.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18: 1–9 PM. Saturday Sept. 19 and Sunday Sept. 20: 9 AM–9 PM.

events.event_name: Brown Bee x Pura Vida Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: Two-day Brown Bee collaboration at Pura Vida Nolita centered on smoothies and skincare/product giveaways.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests are advertised to receive a PB smoothie, a full-size product and an exclusive Brown Bee gift.
events.caveats: Giveaway is limited to the first 100; availability after that is not promised.
events.practical_notes: September 18–19, 10 AM–6 PM daily at Pura Vida Nolita. Published sources describe it as open to the public with no advance RSVP requirement.

events.what_it_is: One-day public KILIAN PARIS activation celebrating the Cocktails Collection with fragrance sampling and mocktails.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary mocktails and fragrance samples; gifts with purchase are separate and require purchase.
events.caveats: Samples and mocktails are while supplies last. Published secondary listings conflict on the street number; the Meatpacking listing and Average Socialite identify 401 W 14th St, while one NYC for FREE page displays 401 E 14th. This record uses the location consistent with the stated Meatpacking District activation.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18, 12–8 PM. Open to the public.

events.what_it_is: Three-day preventive-health pop-up inside Mixed Ingredients with café drinks, grip-strength testing and information about SONATA's membership offering.
events.what_is_free: Public access and grip-strength testing are advertised; café drinks are available but are not established as complimentary.
events.caveats: Do not describe the café drinks as free; the source says visitors can grab the café's signature drinks but does not state they are complimentary.
events.practical_notes: September 18–20, 9 AM–5 PM daily at Mixed Ingredients, 71 Orchard St. Open to the public.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first fully shoppable public café/retail pop-up, built around the Mocha Magic fragrance launch with drinks, sampling, merchandise and gifts.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift. Fragrance sampling is available; published coverage also describes coffee/snacks at the pop-up.
events.caveats: First-50 gift is while supplies last. The space is fully shoppable, so merchandise is paid; do not imply all drinks/merchandise are free unless specifically offered as such onsite.
events.practical_notes: September 18–20, 9 AM–6 PM daily at 262 Mott St. Industry reporting confirms the pop-up is open to the public for retail.

events.what_it_is: Official release-weekend pop-up shop for Miley Cyrus's Bass Persuades, selling exclusive merchandise, limited-edition vinyl and alternate-cover CDs.
events.what_is_free: Entry is open to the public; merchandise is for purchase.
events.caveats: This is primarily a retail pop-up; no unconditional giveaway is established by the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: September 18–19, 12–6 PM daily at 12 E 14th St. Published listings describe the NYC shop as open to the public.
